grades.quote: Traps that increase privilege level are termed _vertical_ traps, while traps that remain at the same privilege level are termed _horizontal_ traps.
grades.reason: Provides background on trap privilege transitions, but does not identify ECALL exceptions or their dependence on originating mode.

grades.quote: RISC-V provides the ecall instruction for system calls; it switches the CPU from user to supervisor mode and jumps to a kernel-specified entry point.
grades.reason: Explains the user-mode ECALL system-call path, but omits the exception identities associated with different originating privilege modes.
Discusses precise versus imprecise vector traps, not ECALL or its mode-dependent exceptions.
